Native macOS MIDI bridge for JUNO-DS Tone Manager 1.01 and original Roland GO:KEYS and GO:PIANO keyboards.

## Download

[Download GO Tone Bridge for macOS](https://github.com/madbadware/go-tone-bridge/releases/latest/download/GO-Tone-Bridge-macOS-universal.zip)

Requires macOS 13 or later. Supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
Extract the ZIP and move **GO Tone Bridge.app** to **Applications**.
JUNO-DS Tone Manager is installed separately.

The app is locally signed and is not notarized. If macOS blocks the first launch,
use **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.
See [Apple's instructions](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445).

## Features

- USB and Bluetooth MIDI connections with automatic model detection.
- Tone Manager identity and catalogue compatibility.
- Parameter reads, patch Preview, and user patch/performance/drum-kit transfers.
- One **Allow writes** control and optional local MIDI logging.

Stored slots may be overwritten when writes are enabled. Back up data before
replacing it. Addresses and wave numbers are preserved; missing samples are
not supplied.
